verdict.rationale: The SDK provides the building blocks for insight-generation agents—custom tools/MCP to query databases and APIs, structured outputs for validated results, and a documented finance-agent example that reads portfolios, evaluates investments, and runs calculations—showing it can be used to build products that surface AI-generated insights from data. However, this is a developer framework, not a turnkey product with a built-in insights UI, so delivering this story requires significant developer implementation. Missing for 10: a first-party end-user-facing insights feature or dashboard, and independent/hands-on evidence of a shipped insights experience built on the SDK.
